text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, the dream stage for El
Condor
Pasa's climactic battle royale
with her friends, is
finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a race where all of the strongest
Umamusume
gather, and for El Condor
Pasa, it's the takeoff
point to the rest of
the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As excitement from the audience
reaches a fever
pitch, all three friends
let each other know they
have no
intention of losing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса steps on to the course of
her
dream match, hoping to claim victory
against her
rivals and take flight around
the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
